about.title: About me
about.0: For almost a decade I have been building data platforms: first in banking (BBVA Next Technologies, Santander Global Tech), then at StratioBD and today at Savana, where I lead Data Management in digital health.
about.1: I am obsessed with data people can trust: governed, interoperable (HL7 FHIR, OMOP CDM) and with measurable quality (UNE 0081). I hold the CDMP certification from DAMA International.
about.2: And because learning is still human, I founded IsAcademy to teach people to think with data and AI.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.0.title: Controller and contact
privacy.0.body: Ismael Sarmiento is the controller for these websites (Home, CV Online and IsAcademy) and IsPanel, his private dashboard. For questions and rights: ismaelantonio.professional@gmail.com.
privacy.1.title: Contact requests · 90 days
privacy.1.body: Submitting a form processes the details you provide (name, email, message and, if supplied, phone, company, interest and level), source website and language. They are kept in a private inbox for 90 days to reply and follow up, with the IP address and available Cloudflare connection context. The form checkbox records your agreement; it does not subscribe you to advertising. You may withdraw consent and request deletion by email.
privacy.2.title: Detailed visits · 30 days
privacy.2.body: One signal per page load helps review usage and operation: path without query parameters, referring domain and language. Cloudflare may supply IP address, country, region, city, approximate location, time zone, network/ASN, data centre, protocol, TLS and connection timing; browser, operating system and device families are derived. Only available, validated fields are retained, for 30 days. Location does not verify identity or a home address. No tracking cookies, persistent identifiers or full User-Agent are stored. This signal respects Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control. You can enable those preferences or request objection/deletion by email.
privacy.3.title: Providers and private access
privacy.3.body: GitHub Pages serves the websites. Cloudflare provides Turnstile protection, Workers, aggregate Web Analytics/Analytics Engine metrics and D1/KV storage; the private D1 database is configured with EU jurisdiction. Resend processes notifications and reports sent to the owner; Gmail receives his email. These providers process necessary data under their own terms, with possible international processing. The panel requires a single-use link (15 minutes); its private session cookie lasts up to 30 days. Reports summarise activity without IP addresses, messages or full contact records.
privacy.4.title: Expiry and copies
privacy.4.body: Expired records become unavailable in the panel and daily cleanup removes the rows. Cloudflare recovery copies may retain them for an additional window (7 days on Free or 30 on Paid). Request emails, reports, provider logs and aggregate metrics have a separate lifecycle; panel retention does not automatically delete them. Report metadata is kept for 30 days and login-link fingerprints until expiry. This information is not sold.
privacy.5.title: Your rights and more information
privacy.5.body: You can request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection and portability where applicable, and withdraw consent, by emailing the address above. If you believe your rights have not been respected, you may contact the AEPD. See also Cloudflare, Turnstile, Resend and GitHub.
